properties.label_detail_en: From 1517 the Ottoman sultans became guardians of Mecca and Medina and the pilgrim routes from Africa (GHA V ch.6 p.138); Ottoman Egypt sent cash, grain and the Ka'ba cover (p.143). End 1916 (Arab Revolt) is a display value not from GHA; the Saudi state is not marked (no page cite read). Open edges: no limit line in the source; not a border.
